pointerEventsNote: Rịba ama: Agbanyụrụ ihe omume pointer ka ịkụ ọkpọ ghara iwepụ onwe ya mgbe a na-efegharị

readableFromJsViaCssVariables: Enwere ike ịgụ ya site na JS site na mgbanwe css:

richTextHeading: Nhazi ederede bara ụba na ngosipụta data ndị ọzọ
inlineCodeExample: Nke a bụ ọmụmaatụ koodu:{code} n'ime paragraf

hrFitContentNote: Mgbe ejikọtara ya na width: fit-content n'isiokwu n'onwe ya, ọ nwere ike ịmachi akara n'okpuru ka ọ bụrụ naanị ederede ahụ
variableLengthDesignTreatment: Ma ọ bụ, ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ogologo na-agbanwe agbanwe, jiri design-treatment:

internalContractsIntro: Nkwekọrịta gafere n'ofe maka ime ihe (aha, ihe ngosi, ihe na-emechi, ihe etinyere, ngalaba nchịkwa). Ndị a bụ ihe nka hax-pattern-library-audit na-enye akara; itinye ya n'ọrụ n'ebe niile na gburugburu bụ ọrụ e mesịa.
